params.caption: 🎮 Take-Two's Zelnick praises Nintendo's Ocarina of Time remake Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick called Nintendo's new Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time "terrific", saying Nintendo should be proud of it. Asked by GamesBeat whether it competes with GTA 6, he said entertainment companies "compete against everything and nothing", since players have endless options but no game is a must-have. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 19:49 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot #Zelda #GTA6 #GamingNews
